set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: H02.1
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Storage/backend engineer
Scope: Build the integrity and repair mechanism that O02.6 qualifies.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: H02 (bd-01M4X8M986VW0MMZ2S4AQDC58C)
Suggested delivery tranche: T3; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Scan retained blob/reference inventories in bounded pages with resumable checkpoints; detect missing, wrong-size and wrong-digest objects and identify all affected dataset/release references without leaking them to unauthorized readers.
2. Quarantine affected retrieval through lifecycle controls; repair only from independently verified matching bytes using an atomic installation protocol, preserving immutable identities and other valid shared references.
3. Exercise interrupted scans/repairs, bad replacement bytes, shared references and concurrent publication; cancellation is bounded and audit/status distinguish detected, quarantined, repaired and unrepairable.

Verification: Filesystem/PostgreSQL corruption and interruption fixtures with byte oracles, bounded memory/scan checkpoints and an operator repair rehearsal.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H02.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O02.4: bd-01M4W5P8JRY7KB6KQJREBCXEAN
- H03.1: bd-01M4X8MA9J2FXA82A9RVB85YD9
- O04.1: bd-01M4W5P9WHJFTH2K179GXKEFW3

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H02.1: Implement bounded integrity scanning and verified repair
